Support waves_per_eu min,max range attribute for full VGPR utilization.

required_patches.description: Allow overriding xnack=any codegen to xnack- or xnack+ on gfx1250 via LLVM_GFX1250_ANY_XNACK_CODEGEN env var.

On pin e2ce52c885 the gfx1250-strict target and its follow-ups are already upstream (64 LDS banks, the VOPD3 FP64 OPY hazard, WMMA feature gating, unscaled f8f6f4 WMMA promotion, clause and cluster handling). This patch keeps only what the pin still lacks: gate the block16 cvt-scale intrinsics, instruction defs and clang builtins behind block16-cvt-scale-insts so gfx1250-strict disables them; drop gfx1200 SWMMAC from the gfx12.5 ISA sets (a1c90088, not in this pin) and the gfx1250 RUN of the sched-group barrier test; and teach MLIR Chipset::parse to ignore processor suffixes such as -strict so convert-gpu-to-rocdl accepts gfx1250-strict. a2c07d5107 (ENABLE_WAVEFRONT_SIZE32) is in the pin and is accepted.
required_patches.upstream_status: residual delta on e2ce52c885; kept block16 cvt-scale gating, gfx1200 SWMMAC removal (a1c90088) and the Chipset suffix. a2c07d5107 accepted.

required_patches.description: Add sched.bank / sched.vgpr / sched.sgpr / sched.agpr hints on pin e2ce52c885. A strict sched.agpr pin stays on the AGPR file: the pseudo is kept through coalescing so the class is not widened to AV_*, and allocation hints admit only that file. Strict sched.vgpr / sched.sgpr pins also keep their pseudo until expandPostRAPseudo, so coalescing cannot drop the exact-register hint and every later use of the pinned value reads the requested register. By default (-amdgpu-strict-pin-tie-src-dst) a strict pin ties its source to its result before register allocation, so the allocator assigns one physical register and expandPostRAPseudo does not emit a copy; passing -amdgpu-strict-pin-tie-src-dst=0 leaves the pseudo untied. regnum -1 (an omitted regnum on the ROCDL ops) pins only the register file, and a soft one has no effect. Strict regnum -1 AGPR pins get one AGPR index per accumulator chain (joined through the pin, the MFMA accumulator input, PHIs and COPYs) when all chains fit, so accumulators stay in place as with explicit indices; otherwise, and for VGPR/SGPR, the hint admits any register of the file and prefers the registers already given to the pin's source and result and the MFMA accumulator input. A strict pin covers the whole variable it starts: AMDGPUCodeGenPrepare gives the same pin to every value that replaces it through a PHI or as an MFMA accumulator (unless the pins of that variable disagree), and the coalescer keeps the pin's hint when it merges the variable's registers, so a value pinned once before a loop keeps one register across iterations. Retargeted from the patch written against 1df311a6: keep the functional changes and drop the clang-format-only churn that does not apply here.
